seo.title: CueBooker | DJ and electronic music booking
seo.description: Discover available artists, send a request and manage electronic music bookings from one connected place.

hero.body: Find artists who fit your date, check availability and start the booking without chasing replies across five channels.

problem.title: Too many channels. No shared state.
problem.body: Instagram for discovery. WhatsApp for the first question. Email to negotiate. A spreadsheet to remember. Another calendar to check the date. The follow-up breaks in between.
problem.statement: There had to be a better way.

search.title: Make the date make sense.
search.body: The demo crosses date, sound, city and budget. Private availability stays under the artist or agency's control.

flow.title: One booking. One thread. One next action.
flow.body: The promoter does not need to install another app. They send the request, receive replies by email and return to the thread through a secure link. The artist or agency keeps status, offer and calendar inside CueBooker.

roles.eyebrow: ONE NETWORK. THREE WAYS OF WORKING.
roles.title: Everyone sees what they need.

items.name: Promoter or venue
items.headline: Find who is actually available.
items.body: Search by date and context, send a complete proposal and follow the conversation without losing the thread.

items.name: Artist
items.headline: Turn an enquiry into a confirmed date.
items.body: Control the availability you share, answer offers and update your calendar from the same workspace.

items.name: Manager or agency
items.headline: Your roster, calendars and every request.
items.body: Route enquiries to the right artist and see what needs attention without checking email chains.

cta.title: We are building CueBooker with people who book real dates.
cta.body: Tell us how you receive and manage bookings. We want to show you the prototype and hear where your current process breaks.
cta.note: No invented promises. First, solve a real workflow.
